edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving Confidential Information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to representatives who need to know it for that purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations. Confidential Information does not include information the receiving party can demonstrate (a) was already known to it without a confidentiality obligation, (b) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement, (c) was independently developed without use of the disclosing party’s Confidential Information, or (d) was lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality obligation. If disclosure is required by law, regulation, or legal process, the receiving party may disclose only the portion required, provided that, to the extent legally permitted, it gives the disclosing party prompt notice and reasonable cooperation in seeking protective treatment. The obligations in this Section continue for three years after disclosure of the applicable Confidential Information.

The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving Confidential Information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to representatives who need to know it for that purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations. These obligations continue for three years after disclosure. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from signing. Expiration does not affect confidentiality obligations that survive under Section 2. On written request, a receiving party shall return or destroy the disclosing party’s Confidential Information, except for copies retained as required by law or bona fide record-retention policies, which remain subject to Section 2. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
